title: Post Quantum Crypto TLS 1.3 in Azure Front Door
contentHtml:
In this episode Michael and Mark talk with guests Vlad Polyakov () and Kunal Samant () about Post Quantum Cryptography TLS 1.3 support in Azure Front Door.
We also discuss Azure Security news about Azure Application Gateway (WAF and IPv6 support), Azure Functions, and Azure Storage.
